seo.title: Carrera Real del Potosí 2026: Night Race Recap, Distances & Kit
seo.description: Recap of the Carrera Real del Potosí 2026 (5th edition): a night race held on Saturday, October 17 at 7:00 p.m. in Parque Tangamanga I. 3K, 6K and 10K, $375 MXN online registration, kit with a light-up wristband and medal.

hero.subtitle: 3K, 6K and 10K under the lights of Parque Tangamanga I
hero.description: The fifth Carrera Real del Potosí was run at night on October 17. Start and finish were on Av. Artesanos, in front of the planetarium, and the kit included a light-up wristband and a medal.

status.title: This race has already taken place
status.description: The Carrera Real del Potosí 2026 was held on Saturday, October 17. When we last checked (October 27), the official event page listed no results, course map, categories or awards.

items.label: Start & finish
items.value: Av. Artesanos, in front of the planetarium, Parque Tangamanga I

kit.title: What was in the race kit
kit.sizes: Shirt sizes ran from XS to 3XL–6XL, chosen at registration.

registration.title: How registration worked
registration.description: Registration was online only, on the Tu Tiempo a Tiempo timing platform: runners chose a distance and shirt size and paid $375 MXN.
registration.policy: Entries were personal, non-transferable and non-refundable.

items.title: Be visible
items.description: Wear the kit's light-up wristband and light-colored or reflective clothing.

items.title: Arrive before sunset
items.description: Finding the planetarium and the start is easier in daylight.

items.title: Layer up for after
items.description: October evenings cool down quickly; bring a sweatshirt for the finish.

items.title: Altitude
items.description: San Luis Potosí sits around 1,860 m. If you're coming from sea level, start easy.

items.q: When was the Carrera Real del Potosí 2026?
items.a: On Saturday, October 17, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. It was the fifth edition and it was run at night.

items.q: Where were the start and finish?
items.a: In Parque Tangamanga I, on Av. Artesanos in front of the planetarium. The finish was in the same spot.

items.q: How much was it and what distances were there?
items.a: $375 MXN for any of the three distances: 3 km, 6 km or 10 km.
Online at tutiempoatiempo.com: runners picked a distance and shirt size and paid. Entries were personal, non-transferable and non-refundable. Registration is closed because the event has ended.
A shirt, medal, bib, timing chip, light-up wristband and a surprise gift.
